title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Rutgers–New Brunswick places for meeting, collaborative work, focused study, and time outdoors.

cards.title: Digital Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Alexander Library, College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Use the first-floor collaboration center to print, work at a computer, book a room, or meet a group before heading across College Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A large library gathering and multimedia-work space.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers describes the Digital Learning Commons as a multimedia collaboration center and its largest indoor student gathering space outside a gymnasium or cafeteria.
cards.source_title: Digital Learning Commons | Rutgers University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Alexander Library; some rooms require reservations.

cards.title: The Cove
cards.subtitle: Busch Student Center, Busch Campus
cards.notes: Set up at the Busch Student Center when your group needs a shared table; the updated space supports both quiet studying and collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A student-center hub for a meeting or study session.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers identifies the Cove in the Busch Student Center as a place for meeting friends, collaborative group work, and quiet studying.
cards.access_notes: Inside Busch Student Center; check the student center for building access and operating details.

cards.title: The Space
cards.subtitle: Livingston Student Center, Livingston Campus
cards.notes: Choose this multipurpose hub for a study break, a small meeting, or a planned rendezvous before moving on to another Livingston stop.
cards.short_summary: A flexible student hub with room to study and meet.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers says the Space in the Livingston Student Center provides study, meeting, and event space.
cards.access_notes: Inside Livingston Student Center; check the student center for building access and operating details.

cards.title: The Atrium
cards.subtitle: College Avenue Student Center, College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Use the renovated College Avenue Student Center area as a meet-up point, then settle in between classes for food or study time.
cards.short_summary: A central student-center space for dining, meetings, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers describes the Atrium as a College Avenue Campus area with dining options and space to meet friends or study between classes.
cards.access_notes: Inside the College Avenue Student Center; food purchases are optional.

cards.title: Rutgers Gardens
cards.subtitle: 130 Log Cabin Road, Rutgers–New Brunswick
cards.notes: Plan a daytime walk through the display gardens and natural areas, or bring a small blanket picnic and carry out everything you bring in.
cards.short_summary: A 180-acre campus botanic garden and outdoor learning setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers Gardens is a 180-acre public botanic garden on the Rutgers–New Brunswick campus with display gardens and natural spaces.
cards.access_notes: Open year-round with no admission fee; seasonal hours and Monday closure apply. Expect uneven outdoor terrain.

cards.title: Archibald S. Alexander Library
cards.subtitle: 169 College Avenue, College Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Use Alexander as a College Avenue starting point for research or study, then reserve a suitable library room when your group needs a dedicated space.
cards.short_summary: The College Avenue library anchor for research and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers lists Alexander Library on the College Avenue Campus and says its libraries provide spaces for research, study, teaching, and collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Library access, services, and room availability vary; consult current library information before visiting.

cards.title: Mabel Smith Douglass Library
cards.subtitle: 8 Chapel Drive, Douglass Campus
cards.notes: Make this named Douglass Campus library your stop for individual reading or shared academic work, and check library services before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A Douglass Campus library destination for academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers lists Douglass Library on Douglass Campus and says its libraries provide spaces for research, study, teaching, and collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Library access, services, and room availability vary; consult current library information before visiting.

cards.title: Chang Science Library
cards.subtitle: Foran Hall, Cook Campus
cards.notes: Head to Foran Hall when you want a Cook Campus research or study stop; use the library’s current service information to plan your visit.
cards.short_summary: A Cook Campus library for research and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers lists Chang Library in Foran Hall on Cook Campus and says its libraries provide spaces for research, study, teaching, and collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Library access, services, and room availability vary; consult current library information before visiting.

cards.title: James Dickson Carr Library
cards.subtitle: 75 Avenue E, Livingston Campus
cards.notes: Use this Livingston Campus library as a quieter academic stop between classes, and verify current services or study-space availability before you go.
cards.short_summary: A Livingston Campus library destination for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers lists Carr Library on Livingston Campus and says its libraries provide spaces for research, study, teaching, and collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Library access, services, and room availability vary; consult current library information before visiting.

cards.title: Library of Science and Medicine
cards.subtitle: 165 Bevier Road, Busch Campus
cards.notes: Use the Busch Campus library for research and studying, and look up bookable rooms if your work needs a more defined setting.
cards.short_summary: A Busch Campus science and health-sciences library.
cards.evidence_claim: Rutgers lists the Library of Science and Medicine on Busch Campus and says its libraries provide spaces for research, study, teaching, and collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Library access, services, and room availability vary; consult current library information before visiting.
